text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "pounds", "kind": "count", "span": "mine 12 pounds of ore per day with his bare hands"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "mine twice as much with an iron pickaxe"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "50% more with a steel pickaxe than with an iron pickaxe"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 40, "unit": "dwarves", "kind": "count", "span": "40 dwarves with steel pickaxes"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 30, "unit": "days", "kind": "count", "span": "a month with 30 days"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "bare-hand rate times two = iron pickaxe rate"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "iron pickaxe rate times 50% = the steel pickaxe's extra ore"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "iron pickaxe rate plus the extra = steel pickaxe rate"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "steel pickaxe rate times number of dwarves = ore per day for all dwarves"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s4", "q5"], "out": "s5", "note": "ore per day times days in the month"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "pounds of ore 40 dwarves with steel pickaxes can mine in a month"}, "dismissed": []}
